spec.studio_prompt: A modern round bistro table measuring 60 cm in diameter and 72 cm in height. The tabletop is a circular slab of white marble (#cccdd5) patterned with subtle grey veining (#858385) and finished with a smooth, honed edge. The understructure consists of four slender, straight legs made from square-profile metal tubing in a matte black finish (#211f1e, #3e3936). The legs connect at the bottom into a clean X-shaped floor cross-frame.
